items.text: Lydia A. Gutiérrez is a public school teacher. According to her campaign, she has taught in public schools for more than 30 years and previously worked in the aerospace industry as an administrator and acting cost estimating supervisor. Her website states she served seven years as an elected board member of the Coastal San Pedro Neighborhood Council, where she sat on the Public Safety, Budget & Finance, Education, and Cultural committees. Her campaign also notes she is a co-chair of the California Teachers Association's State Legislative Committee for Adult, Alternative, and Career Technical Education.
